🎄✨ AUDITIONS! ✨🎄
A CHRISTMAS CAROL — A LIVE RADIO PLAY 🎙️🔔
Step into the magic of Christmas and bring this beloved classic to life in a fun, unique live radio play!
🎭 Auditions are coming!
We are currently seeking 5 featured actors:�👨 3 Men�👩 2 Women
All ages 20-infinite �✨ Additional roles may be available!
No previous radio-play experience is necessary—just a love for storytelling, a willingness to have fun, and a voice ready to transport our audience to the most wonderful time of the year!
🎙️ Multiple characters, sound effects, holiday spirit, and lots of Christmas magic await!
If you love the stage, enjoy performing, or have always wanted to try something different this is the time!
🎄 Come be part of the story that reminds us all what Christmas is truly about. ❤️
Audition Date & Time:
Oct 11 @ 2pm, Oct 12 @ 6pm
Location: TCT Off-Broadway
213 East Franklin St.
Audition material will be provided
Performance dates:Dec 10-12
✨ “God bless us, every one!” ✨
